{{Quote|Get over there. Take whatever you need. Hire whomever you need. Maybe, just maybe they're too tired to ask questions and will retire for the rest of the day. If not&mdash;if it appears they are coming out and heading for the Cuipernam municipal complex&mdash;stop them. Do whatever you must. But keep them from reaching the complex. They must not be allowed to interfere with the vote of the Unity delegation.|Soergg the Hutt, to his majordomo, Ogomoor|<ref name="The Approaching Storm" />}}
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], during a [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] [[Border dispute on Ansion/Legends|diplomatic mission]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]], a '''skirmish''' took place in [[Cuipernam]], Ansion's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]]. The skirmish occurred shortly after [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], with their [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], returned to Cuipernam to deliver word of their success in reaching a satisfying accord with the [[Borokii]] and the [[Januul]], two feuding [[Alwari]] [[overclan]]s. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and their companions, [[Kyakhta]], [[Bulgan]], and [[Tooqui]], returned to the same [[Unidentified Cuipernam Inn|inn]] where they had stayed before leaving Cuipernam in search of the Alwari. There they learned that a vote to determine whether Ansion remained within the Republic was to take place that same [[Standard day/Legends|day]].

Within three minutes of the Jedi and their companions setting out for the [[Cuipernam municipal complex|municipal building]], where the [[Unity of Community]] (Ansion's government) was holding the vote, the inn exploded. While en route, the group was attacked by [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] sent by [[Soergg Vosadii Bezhin|Soergg the Hutt]], a [[bossban]] allied with [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]] of the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]]. These mercenaries drove the Jedi into a [[Unidentified building (Cuipernam)|building]], with [[Sniper/Legends|snipers]] at the ready to [[Death/Legends|eliminate]] them when they attempted to leave. However, the timely appearance of an [[honor guard]] from both the Borokii and Januul overclans saved the Jedi. The Alwari warriors eliminated the snipers and began picking off the remaining mercenaries.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|The Unity delegation is voting on the matter of secession from the Republic today.|A Dbarian inn manager, to the Jedi|<ref name="The Approaching Storm" />}}
During the growing [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], in which many [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] seceded from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to form the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Dooku/Legends|Darth Tyranus]] and [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] [[Presidente]] [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]] led a plot to have the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]] secede from the Republic.

Ansion lay at the heart of several treaties, meaning its secession from the Republic would in turn cause the secession of many other worlds. To prevent this, the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] dispatched [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and their respective [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]], [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], on a [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] [[Border dispute on Ansion/Legends|mission]] to convince the [[Unity of Community]], the government of Ansion, which was based in the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Cuipernam]], to stay within the Republic. The Unity would only remain within the Republic if the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] could negotiate a treaty with the planet's native [[Alwari]] clans, nomadic groups of [[Ansionian]]s. To this end, the Jedi succeeded in negotiating an arrangement with the [[Borokii]] and [[Januul]] [[overclan]]s, in which the Alwari would share dominion with the Unity of over half or more of their land.<ref name="The Approaching Storm" />

After negotiating this arrangement, the Jedi and their companions, Ansionians [[Kyakhta]] and [[Bulgan]] and the [[Gwurran]] [[Tooqui]], returned to the [[Unidentified Cuipernam Inn|inn]] at which they stayed prior to leaving Cuipernam in search of the Alwari. While there, the group learned from the [[Dbarian]] inn [[Unidentified Dbarian inn manager|manager]] that the vote for secession was scheduled to take place that [[Standard day/Legends|day]]. After trying to contact several members of the Unity via [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], the group discovered that [[United Ouruvot Communications]], the municipal entity responsible for such, had shut down all communications in the city. The Jedi and their companions then headed toward the municipal hall, where the secession vote was taking place. Meanwhile, [[Soergg Vosadii Bezhin|Soergg the Hutt]], the Cuipernam [[bossban]] allied with Shu Mai, ordered his [[Majordomo/Legends|majordomo]], [[Ogomoor]], to prevent the Jedi from interfering with the vote by any means necessary.<ref name="The Approaching Storm" />

==The skirmish==
{{Quote|The Jedi are retreating! Let them all back out onto the street before you resume fire. We don't want even one of them to get away.|Ogomoor, to the contracted snipers|<ref name="The Approaching Storm" />}}
The inn exploded only three [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]] after the Jedi departed. Nevertheless, the diplomatic envoy continued on foot toward the municipal hall. As they walked, Master Unduli sensed a [[Disturbance in the Force/Legends|disturbance]] and silently warned Master Kenobi, Offee, and Skywalker. Kenobi then alerted Kyakhta and Bulgan, though the Jedi decided not to tell Tooqui, as it would only panic him. Ogomoor's [[Sniper/Legends|snipers]] suddenly opened fire from the rooftoops, though the Jedi deflected their shots and quickly ducked into a [[Unidentified building (Cuipernam)|large trading establishment]] with their companions. Ogomoor ordered his [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] to follow the Jedi into the building with the intent of driving them out onto the street, where his snipers could pick them off. Dozens of professional [[Death/Legends|killers]] swarmed into the building and opened fire, unconcerned with civilian casualties. A [[Unidentified Vrot|Vrot]] mercenary tried to attack Unduli from behind, but Tooqui, Kyakhta, and Bulgan stopped him.<ref name="The Approaching Storm" />

Unduli and Kenobi decided that retreating onto the street was the best option to protect the civilians in the building. Ogomoor ordered the snipers to let the Jedi back onto the street before resuming fire. One [[Unidentified sniper (Cuipernam)|sniper]] inquired about killing Tooqui, Kyakhta, and Bulgan, but Ogomoor said that others on the ground would take care of them and to kill Kenobi and Unduli first, followed by their Padawans. Before the snipers could open fire, however, elite [[Honor guard|honor-guard]] warriors from both the [[Situng Borokii]] and the [[Hovsgol Januul]], led by [[Bayaar]], a clan member of the Situng Borokii, descended upon them. As the Alwari overpowered the remaining snipers and began eliminating the rest of the mercenaries, Ogomoor fled.<ref name="The Approaching Storm" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|What is this?"''<br />''"Your honor guard, noble Obi-Wan. Don't you remember being promised a present by the twinned Council of Alwari Elders? This is it. They didn't want anything to happen to their new offworld friends. Especially not before the formal treaty between the Alwari and the Unity is put in place.|Bayaar explains to Kenobi the Alwari presence in Cuipernam|<ref name="The Approaching Storm" />}}
As the remaining mercenaries fled, Bayaar revealed to the Jedi that he had been sent with warriors from both the Borokii and the Januul to protect them. The honor guard he captained constituted a gift to the Jedi from the united Alwari councils.

After failing to eliminate the Jedi, Ogomoor, weary of reporting failures to Soergg, later burst into the municipal building while the Jedi were meeting with the Unity of Community antecedent to their vote, claiming to have information that would be useful in the rendering of their decision about secession. However, before Ogomoor could hand over the recording containing what was apparently incriminating information, Soergg shot him dead. The Hutt claimed he had no way of knowing Ogomoor's intentions when his [[majordomo]] reached into his pocket for what may have been a weapon, for all anyone knew. Of course, the shot that killed Ogomoor also destroyed the recording. Notwithstanding—and to the Hutt's great dismay and fury—the Unity Council went on to vote to remain within the Republic.<ref name="The Approaching Storm" />

==Behind the scenes==
This skirmish first appeared in the [[2002]] novel ''[[The Approaching Storm]]'', written by [[Alan Dean Foster]].<ref name="The Approaching Storm" />
